Results.ReviewText: Je suis insatisfait de la performance de non barbecue Genesis® II E-210 Gas Grill et cela malgré les efforts que WEBER a fait en me fournissant gratuitement certaines pièces qui auraient pu être défectueuses, ce qui n'était pas le cas. Ce barbecue est plus dispendieux que les concurrents, on doit donc s’attendre à une bonne performance. La chaleur atteint 460 degrés en 11 minutes, 500 en 15,5 minutes, 520 en 20 minutes et 530 en 30 minutes et cela par temps CHAUD sans VENT ce qui est insatisfaisant. 550 degrés est impossible à atteindre dans un délai raisonnable! Pourtant il est dit EXPLICITEMENT dans les spécifications que ce barbecue devrait atteindre 500 degrés en 10 minutes.  (RÉF : PAGE 43 du GUIDE)  Et dès que l’on ouvre le couvercle pour y placer notre viande, il perd rapidement sa chaleur. Je dois pratiquement mettre les contrôles au maximum en permanence… Vous me direz que j’aurais dû acheter un plus puissant, (plus de 26 000BTU)c’est vrai mais je me suis fier à la documentation de WEBER.   Malheureusement je n’ai pas la chance de « bien saisir mes superbes marques de viande » pour faire le bonheur de mes invités comme le dit votre documentation. Je demeure donc insatisfait des performances de mon barbecue EN CONSIDÉRANT LE PRIX QUE J’AI PAYÉ. Je ne recommande donc pas ce type de barbecue.

Results.ReviewText: I chose Weber because of previous experience with the brand and the high ratings it gets from independent testing. I chose the Spirit E-210 because of its small size. It fits nicely on my upper deck which is just outside my kitchen. The convenient location means I use it often, about 3+ times a week. The two shelves fold down for a very small footprint. It comes up to temperature very quickly and achieves surprisingly high temps (500+) . Even with just two burners, it is easy to create direct and indirect heat zones to suit whatever you are grilling. We are a small family of three, and this grill is more than adequate for our needs. When we have company and need more capacity, I go downstairs to the larger lower deck, where I have a larger unit. I use the E-210 more than my other grills by far. This grill is perfect for my situation and I love it. I highly recommend getting a Weber for their quality and performance. I have found that spending just a little more than the cheaper brands is more than worth it for the satisfaction it delivers.

Results.ReviewText:
I have been using this grill almost daily now for the past two months and am thoroughly satisfied. You get your money's worth in terms of quality.
With its fold down sides it takes up a modest footprint in my small back yard and yet has sufficient grilling area to cook for eight or more with ease. It ignites with no hiccups and heats to 500F in less than 10 minutes. This burns off most of the debris from the previous use. Once I've taken my stainless steel bristle to it, I put on a heat-proof mitt and wipe down the grids with a paper towel soaked with a bit of cooking oil. I find this makes the grids effectively non-stick.
I've used it for various methods -- direct heat, indirect heat and as an alternative to a conventional oven and it has performed well in each scenario. I do find it helps to use a hard bristle tooth brush to clean the holes in the burners carefully and periodically. Depending on the kind of grilling I've been doing, I lift out the grids etc. so I can clean the sides and bottom with a plastic scraper. Too much fatty, sugary (BBQ sauce) build-up and the thing will flare alarmingly!
This is my first Weber and of the previous grills I've owned it is far and away the easiest to assemble. It really helps to read the instructions first! In all it took me just over an hour.
The built-in weigh-scale for the propane tank is very useful and pretty accurate. Besides, it's always prudent to keep a full tank on standby as a precaution.
I also bought the custom Weber cover for this grill and am hoping it will extend its life by reducing rust. We'll see in a few year's time.

ClientResponses.Response:
Hello, we are very sorry to hear about this issue.It sounds like you may be activating a safety device built into the regulator.To ensure that you are not inadvertently activating the safety device as you turn on the grill, please use the following procedure:

-Turn all burner control knobs to OFF, including the side burner control knob if present.

-Make sure the grill lid is open. Open the LP tank valve and then wait at least 60 seconds. This will allow the hose and regulator to pressurize.

-Turn the appropriate burner control knob for your model grill to the START/HIGH position and then ignite the grill by pushing the ignition button.

-Turn each of the other burner control knobs to high, one at a time, and press the igniter button (if applicable for your model). Repeat this process until all the burners have been lit.

-Close the grill lid.

-The grill should reach approximately 500 to 550 degrees in 10-15 minutes.

If you still experience an issue reaching temperature please contact our support team for further assistance. Thanks!
ClientResponses.Name: Weber Grills

46110001.Description:
Taste the difference a Spirit will make in your life. With features such as porcelain enameled, cast-iron cooking grates that retain even heat, you’re guaranteed the best tasting food.
